decisions.reason: As a recently launched Magento shop template that is adjacent to the firm's shop-hosting business, it is still an option worth keeping open, though its peripheral fit and maintenance needs make discontinuation fairly plausible.
The responsive website template complements the firm's agency and developer customers, and with low marginal cost and still-unresolved demand uncertainty it is more sensible to keep than to exit now.
Premium customer support is very close to the firm's core value proposition and can be continued cheaply while the firm learns about willingness to pay, so dropping it soon is unlikely.

A software version management tool fits the firm's strategy of reducing recurring operational work and, having been given its own page, looks like a strategic option to retain while adoption develops.

The data processing contract tool supports hosting customers' compliance needs and is inexpensive to leave in the portfolio, although its narrower, regulation-driven use case raises the chance of later withdrawal somewhat.
